channel.title: Free LLM API Tokens — What’s new
channel.description: Providers added, changed or removed on the Free LLM API Tokens tracker, grouped by date.

item.title: 13 Nov 2026: 9 providers added, 3 updated
item.description:
Changes recorded on 13 Nov 2026.

  • Added Vectoree.
  • Added GonkaRouter.
  • Added Speka.
  • Added Braintrust.
  • Added Liquid AI.
  • Added Together AI.
  • Added Novita AI.
  • Added NLP Cloud.
  • Added IBM watsonx.ai.
  • Updated Gemini API (Google AI Studio): training-data policy.
  • Updated SenseNova Token Plan: phone requirement.
  • Updated Hyperbolic: offer type and phone requirement.
  • Updated offer type across 22 existing providers.
  • Added optional free_type, phone_required and data_training fields, plus filters, a public JSON schema, and copy-paste starter snippets.
